text.arabic_uthmani: تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّٰرِ

words.gloss_range: collective calling directed at one speaker, then judged by its requested outcome
words.root_gloss_range: call, summon, invite, appeal, or claim; local value is determined by the destination and governed purpose clauses
words.prose: {{ar:تَدْعُونَنِى}} ({{tr:tadʿūnanī}}) opens with a plural caller pressing a singular object, so the social summons is aimed at one accountable self. The verb remains a neutral call-root until the following purpose frame exposes its destination: demanded kufr and shirk. It also sets up the mirror with the later ʾadʿūkum counter-call, where the same root reverses direction and becomes a call toward named divine titles. Across the boundary from 40:41, the repeated call language specifies what the prior fire-directed invitation contains (40:41).

topics.headline: plural pressure on one accountable self
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a collective pressure is grammatically routed onto one speaker rather than left as a vague social mood.
topics.reason: The plural subject and singular object suffix are confirmed by QAC grammar and attachment evidence, so the CRITICAL pressure-on-one-self topic survives.

topics.headline: call judged by its endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that daʿwah is evaluated by the outcome it opens, not by the mere fact of calling.
topics.reason: The verb is followed by purpose clauses for kufr and shirk, and lexical evidence keeps the d-ʿ-w range neutral until destination supplies moral direction.

topics.headline: same-surah call thread specified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects this opening to 40:41, where the broad call contrast is now specified as kufr and unwarranted shirk.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete same-surah continuity with 40:41, and no guardrail evidence contradicts that boundary reading.

topics.headline: reversed call echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the same call-root reverse roles: they call me, while I call you.
topics.reason: The later verb uses the same root with reversed object suffixes, so the echo is locally anchored in surface morphology and discourse order.

words.gloss_range: purpose lām binding their call to the first demanded act and the shared outcome frame
words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) is the small hinge that turns the preceding tadʿūnanī call into a purpose frame. It looks backward to the call and forward to ʾakfura, then continues through the coordinated ʾushrika. The contrast with later ilā matters: their summons is toward requested acts, while the speaker call is toward a named destination.

topics.headline: purpose hinge into demanded act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the invitation is grammatically aimed at producing an act, not merely followed by an accidental consequence.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the particle as the purpose lām governing the following subjunctive, with purpose/result pressure locally coherent.

topics.headline: shared double-outcome frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees kufr and shirk held inside one summoned program rather than as unrelated accusations.
topics.reason: The coordinated second subjunctive remains under the purpose construction, so the two harmful outcomes belong to one call frame.

topics.headline: lām versus ilā
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah contrast recruitment into acts with orientation toward a divine endpoint.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL synthesis is supported by the later ilā destination phrase and the attachment analysis of both prepositional frames.

words.gloss_range: first-person dependent kufr act, specified by the following bi-domain
words.root_gloss_range: covering, denial, rejection, and culpable concealment; locally the demanded act is rejection in relation to Allāh, not mere uncertainty
words.prose: {{ar:أَكْفُرَ}} ({{tr:ʾakfura}}) is first person and subjunctive after the purpose lām, so the demanded kufr is the speaker own possible act but grammatically exposed as their desired outcome. The following bi-llāhi domain prevents the denial from floating as a general attitude: it bears on the named divine referent. The k-f-r field makes denial an active covering or rejection, and 40:12 supplies the same-surah kufr-and-shirk backdrop now turned into direct recruitment (40:12). The covering image then prepares the reversal at al-ghaffār, where covering becomes protective forgiveness rather than culpable denial.

topics.headline: dependent first-person kufr
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the speaker is being pressed toward his own act of denial, yet the grammar marks that act as dependent on their call.
topics.reason: The lām-governed subjunctive, first-person prefix, and Form I shape are locally confirmed by QAC grammar and attachment support.

topics.headline: rejection domain named by bi
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disbelief is not generic; it is directed toward the divine name named by the bi-complement.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence makes the bi phrase the complement/domain of the verb, preserving the CRITICAL domain topic.

topics.headline: covering and identity field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees kufr as active covering or rejection, with 40:12 providing a same-surah backdrop for the kufr-and-shirk pairing (40:12).
topics.reason: The lexical family and same-surah pair evidence support the covering/rejection field while local grammar keeps this as the demanded act in 40:42.

topics.headline: kufr before shirk and ghafr reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sequence move from denying Allāh before assigning a rival, and later hears that culpable covering answered by forgiving covering.
topics.reason: The order of the two subjunctives and the final gh-f-r title are both surface-local, so the sequencing and reversal payoff survives.

words.gloss_range: object-domain marker fastening kufr to the divine name
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) after ʾakfura marks the domain or object of rejection. Its local job is not instrumentality; it fastens the act to Allāh. The clitic form makes that relation visibly bound rather than an explanatory afterthought.

topics.headline: bi as domain, not instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the preposition makes Allāh the rejected domain, not a means by which something else happens.
topics.reason: The local kufr frame and attachment evidence select complement/domain marking, blocking an instrumental reading.

topics.headline: bound complement blocks abstraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that disbelief is grammatically fastened to the named referent rather than allowed to remain abstract.
topics.reason: The proclitic form and immediate noun complement preserve the CRITICAL surface-binding payoff.

words.gloss_range: definite divine name as known worship-referent before the vague associate
words.root_gloss_range: worship, deity, devotion, and disputed derivational associations; locally the proper name anchors the worship-authority violated by kufr and shirk
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:allāhi}}) is grammatically genitive after bi, but semantically it anchors the whole accusation. The definite proper name stands before the vague mā, so the known worship-referent appears before the proposed associate is introduced and disqualified. Its worship-authority field makes shirk an invasion of the proper divine slot, with 112:1 sharpening the oneness pressure (112:1). The first bihi then carries this divine referent forward into the shirk construction, and the later title pair retrieves the surah opening horizon of authority and forgiveness (40:2).

topics.headline: known name before unknown associate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the known divine name arrives before the vague proposed partner, making the associate secondary from the start.
topics.reason: The proper definite form precedes the indefinite relative object, and no evidence dislodges that local ordering payoff.

topics.headline: semantic center despite genitive case
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that case government does not make the divine referent peripheral; the argument still turns around Him.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence confirm genitive government by bi while the clause structure keeps the name as the object-domain of kufr and antecedent of bihi.

topics.headline: worship-authority field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees shirk as an invasion of the proper worship-reference of Allāh, with 112:1 sharpening the oneness pressure (112:1).
topics.reason: The derivational dispute is narrowed to worship-authority because the local frame is kufr and shirk in relation to the divine name.

topics.headline: divine name carried by pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks how the divine name remains present in the next phrase through the first bihi pronoun.
topics.reason: Attachment and pronoun routing support the first bihi as referring back to Allāh, preserving the CRITICAL echo.

topics.headline: surah title retrieval
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can connect the closing title pair back to the surah opening where divine authority and forgiveness are already foregrounded (40:2).
topics.reason: The row supplies a concrete same-surah title connection; it is kept as a contextual bridge without letting it override the local parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating wāw adding shirk as a second outcome within the same purpose frame
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) before ʾushrika keeps the second verb coordinated with ʾakfura under the earlier purpose frame. It does not open a separate accusation; it makes denial and association distinct but inseparable outcomes of one summons.

topics.headline: shared subjunctive coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the second harmful act inherit the first purpose frame without needing another lām.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms coordination of the second subjunctive with the first under the same purpose construction.

topics.headline: distinct but cumulative harms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the invitation is internally doubled: denial and association remain separate acts inside one program.
topics.reason: The additive conjunction and bound surface form preserve the CRITICAL payoff of cumulative, not collapsed, outcomes.

words.gloss_range: Form IV first-person shirk act assigning a partner beside Allāh under a no-knowledge filter
words.root_gloss_range: sharing, partnership, association, and allotted share; locally narrowed to unauthorized theological association with Allāh
words.prose: {{ar:أُشْرِكَ}} ({{tr:ʾushrika}}) completes the second demanded outcome. Its construction separates roles: the first bihi marks the one associated with, while mā names the would-be associated object. Form IV makes the error an assigned relation, not a discovered warrant, and the following no-knowledge clause rejects that assignment from inside the object phrase. That epistemic filter places this shirk refusal beside the wider judgment that shirk is grave wrong (31:13).

topics.headline: split complement shirk construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that bihi and mā do different jobs: relation target and partner-object are not confused.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms bihi as complement and mā as object, preserving the split-governance topic.

topics.headline: unauthorized sharing beside Allāh
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices ordinary sharing-language becomes a theological violation when attached to Allāh.
topics.reason: V4 lexical range allows sharing/partnership, while the local Allāh pronoun narrows it to unauthorized association.

topics.headline: Form IV assigned relation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the proposed shirk as a relation the speaker would be asked to assign, not something already warranted.
topics.reason: QAC form evidence supports Form IV, and the local construction makes the actor-assigned relation meaningful.

topics.headline: knowledge filter on shirk
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees association rejected by an epistemic test, with 31:13 offering a concrete backdrop for shirk as grave wrong (31:13).
topics.reason: The following relative no-knowledge clause and the intertext rows support the epistemic mechanism while local grammar governs the parse.

words.gloss_range: first bihi as the relation target referring back to Allāh
words.prose: The first {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) is the relation target in the ʾushrika bihi construction. Its suffix most directly resumes Allāh, so it means association with Him, not by means of Him. The later identical bihi must be parsed differently, which makes syntax do real work.

topics.headline: relation target, not direct object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the divine relation target from the associated object that follows.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this bihi a prepositional complement of the shirk verb while mā remains the object.

topics.headline: Allāh antecedent, not instrument
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks Allāh into the shirk phrase through the suffix and avoids reading the pronoun as a means.
topics.reason: The nearest coherent antecedent is the divine name, and the local verb frame selects association-with rather than instrumentality.

topics.headline: two bihi precision
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that identical surface forms carry different referents, forcing careful syntax rather than sound-based guessing.
topics.reason: The repeated bihi forms are locally present and attachment evidence separates their roles: divine relation here, epistemic topic later.

words.gloss_range: indefinite relative object introduced for scrutiny and defined by lack of knowledge
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the object of ʾushrika and the head of the relative clause that follows. Its unspecified form withholds any named rival; whatever associate is being proposed must pass the knowledge test, and the clause delays that decisive failure until ʿilmun.

topics.headline: object plus relative head
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the proposed partner both introduced and judged within one compact grammatical structure.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies mā as the object associated with the verb and as qualified by the following laysa clause.

topics.headline: unnamed filterable partner
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the refusal applies to any unnamed associate that cannot survive the knowledge clause.
topics.reason: The uninflected relative form leaves the partner unspecified, supporting a widened but locally bounded refusal.

topics.headline: delayed disqualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the object placed under suspense before the final knowledge veto is named.
topics.reason: The word order introduces mā before the laysa clause completes the disqualification, so the structural payoff survives.

words.gloss_range: negative copular clause denying epistemic warrant for the proposed associate
words.root_gloss_range: negation through the frozen negative copula; locally a structured denial of possession of knowledge, not direct denial of the object itself
words.prose: {{ar:لَيْسَ}} ({{tr:laysa}}) builds a full negative predication, not a bare no. It does not simply deny the existence of mā; it denies the speaker possession of knowledge concerning it, which is stronger than merely saying he does not know it. This applies the no-knowledge rule to worship-association (17:36), and the first-person thread from -nī to lī to anā keeps the refusal personally accountable. By filtering the object before the counter-call begins, the grammar makes unsupported association fail before the answer turns outward.

topics.headline: negative epistemic predication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees lack of warrant asserted as a structured state, not as casual ignorance.
topics.reason: QAC identifies laysa as an uninflected negative copular verb, and attachment evidence supplies the fronted predicate and delayed subject.

topics.headline: more than I do not know it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase denies possession of warrant rather than merely reporting a momentary failure to know.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL distinction is supported by the laysa-plus-possessive construction and is not contradicted by guardrail evidence.

topics.headline: knowledge rule applied to shirk
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links the refusal to the Quranic no-knowledge rule in 17:36, now applied to worship-association (17:36).
topics.reason: The row provides the concrete 17:36 parallel, while local syntax keeps the rule applied to the relative object in 40:42.

topics.headline: relative filter before counter-call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the proposed associate disqualified before the ayah pivots to the positive counter-call.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the laysa clause as the relative modifier of mā before the contrast clause begins.

topics.headline: first-person refusal thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader follows the same targeted self from -nī, to lī, to explicit anā: he will not own a claim without knowledge.
topics.reason: The first-person markers and stacked laysa configuration are surface-local and jointly support the CRITICAL synthesis.

words.gloss_range: fronted first-person possession phrase making absent warrant personally accountable
words.prose: {{ar:لِى}} ({{tr:lī}}) comes before the knowledge noun, making the speaker non-possession of warrant the first pressure point inside the relative clause. The lām marks availability or possession of knowledge, and the suffix ties the refusal to the same self targeted earlier by tadʿūnanī.

topics.headline: fronted non-possession of warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears whose warrant is absent before the abstract noun knowledge is even named.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes lī the fronted predicate phrase of laysa, and word order preserves the fronting payoff.

topics.headline: first-person accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the refusal as personal accountability, not a detached theoretical objection.
topics.reason: The first-person suffix is surface-local and links to the earlier and later first-person markers.

topics.headline: possession as warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that knowledge is treated as something one must possess as warrant before accepting the proposed association.
topics.reason: The lām with the knowledge noun locally licenses possession or availability of warrant rather than spatial nearness.

words.gloss_range: second bihi as the epistemic topic referring to mā
words.prose: The second {{ar:بِهِۦ}} ({{tr:bihi}}) shifts antecedent to mā. With ʿilmun, it means concerning the proposed associate, not association with Allāh. The repeated surface form therefore separates divine relation from epistemic topic by syntax alone.

topics.headline: mā antecedent for absent knowledge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the pronoun to the proposed associate rather than back to Allāh.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence links this bihi to the knowledge noun and the relative object, supporting the mā antecedent.

topics.headline: bi as knowledge topic
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this bi mark the topic of knowledge, not the target of association.
topics.reason: The local collocation with ʿilmun licenses concerning/about, while the earlier bihi has a different verb frame.

topics.headline: same form, new referent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that identical forms demand different antecedents, so syntax carries the distinction.
topics.reason: The two bihi forms are identical in surface shape but differ by attachment and clause role, preserving the pronoun-pivot topic.

words.gloss_range: indefinite delayed knowledge noun as clause-final veto
words.root_gloss_range: knowledge, marking, recognition, and warrant; locally the required warrant for any God-claim, denied under negation
words.prose: {{ar:عِلْمٌۭ}} ({{tr:ʿilmun}}) arrives last in the no-knowledge clause. As an indefinite verbal noun under negation, it denies any valid knowledge concerning the proposed associate, not just one missing proof. The final position lets knowledge land as the veto before the ayah turns to the speaker counter-call and eventually to definite divine titles. That veto applies the no-knowledge rule of 17:36 to the shirk object and helps turn the broad 40:41 destination contrast into specific theological content (17:36; 40:41). Its indefinite sound also contrasts with the later definite title closure.

topics.headline: indefinite under negation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the denial exclude any qualifying warrant, not merely a named proof.
topics.reason: The nominal indefiniteness and laysa negation are surface-local, and guardrail evidence confirms ʿilmun as delayed subject.

topics.headline: delayed subject veto
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels knowledge arrive after possessor and topic have been fixed, making it the clause-final veto.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies ʿilmun as the delayed noun of laysa after lī bihi.

topics.headline: knowledge as warrant for God-claims
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees knowledge functioning as authorization for allegiance and worship-claims, not as curiosity.
topics.reason: The lexical field is narrowed by the local shirk object and no-knowledge construction to warrant for religious association.

topics.headline: no-knowledge rule and boundary bridge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the no-knowledge rule of 17:36 to this compact shirk filter, while 40:41-40:42 turns broad destinations into theological content (17:36; 40:41).
topics.reason: The concrete intertext and boundary rows support the epistemic bridge without adding an unattested local topic.

topics.headline: indefinite sound before definite titles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices absent, indefinite warrant contrasted with the later named definite titles.
topics.reason: The masdar form and tanwīn are visible locally, while the title closure supplies the contrast named by the CRITICAL rows.

words.gloss_range: contrastive wāw opening the independent counter-call
words.prose: The second {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) pivots from the disqualified object to the speaker answer. Because it introduces the ʾanā ʾadʿūkum clause, it links the debate while turning its direction: you call me toward those acts, while I call you toward a named divine endpoint.

topics.headline: contrastive counter-clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the conjunction open a whole answering clause, not merely add another phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the clause from word 14 to 19 as the contrastive counter-call, preserving the CRITICAL scope.

topics.headline: continuity with a turn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the argument stays in one debate while reversing direction.
topics.reason: The broad wa range is locally narrowed by the explicit pronoun and counter-call to contrastive continuation.

words.gloss_range: explicit first-person pronoun making the counter-caller visible at the hinge
words.prose: {{ar:أَنَا۠}} ({{tr:ʾanā}}) is not needed for first-person marking because ʾadʿūkum already carries it. Its presence makes the speaker stance visible before the counter-call: you call me, but I call you. The recitational length noted at wa-ʾanā gives the hinge audible weight without changing the referent or grammar.

topics.headline: contrastive self-position
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the speaker step into view as the pivot between rejected summons and counter-summons.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun before a first-person verb is locally marked and supported by attachment evidence as explicit subject.

topics.headline: identity hinge in the address reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn in agency before the repeated call-root reverses direction.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL synthesis follows the local sequence wa plus independent pronoun plus counter-call.

topics.headline: madd sound hinge without grammar change
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the self-pivot receive recitational weight while keeping the same first-person reference.
topics.reason: The qiraat/madd rows are preserved as sound and pause payoff, narrowed so they do not change the consonantal form, referent, or clause grammar.

words.gloss_range: independent counter-call directly addressing the plural audience toward a named destination
words.root_gloss_range: call, summon, invite, appeal, or claim; locally positive redirection because ilā names the divine endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:أَدْعُوكُمْ}} ({{tr:ʾadʿūkum}}) answers the opening call with the same root but reversed direction. It is indicative and independent, not governed by the earlier purpose lām, and its suffix makes the plural audience the direct object while ilā names the separate destination. The same act of calling becomes valid by being oriented toward al-ʿazīz al-ghaffār, unlike the false caller contrast where blame is disowned in 14:22 (14:22).

topics.headline: independent indicative counter-call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the reply regain finite independence after the dependent demanded outcomes.
topics.reason: QAC grammar confirms the indicative verb, and attachment evidence places it in the independent contrast clause.

topics.headline: audience and destination separated
topics.reader_payoff: The reader distinguishes the people being addressed from the goal toward which they are being called.
topics.reason: The object suffix and ilā complement have distinct local roles confirmed by morphology and attachments.

topics.headline: positive daʿwah by endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same call-root become truthful because its named endpoint bears warrant, with 14:22 contrasting a false caller who disowns blame (14:22).
topics.reason: The lexical call-field is narrowed by ilā and the divine titles; the concrete 14:22 row is retained as contrast.

topics.headline: reversal of opening call
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the pressured object become the active caller back to the plural audience.
topics.reason: The same root appears in words 1 and 16 with reversed person and object suffixes, making the echo surface-local.

words.gloss_range: destination preposition governing the paired divine title endpoint
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَى}} ({{tr:ilā}}) turns the counter-call toward a terminus rather than into a requested act. It governs the destination phrase through both al-ʿazīz and al-ghaffār. This preposition shift from earlier li carries the argument: their call recruits into acts; his call orients toward the divine source those acts deny. The ilā direction also refines the opposed destinations from 40:41 by naming the speaker salvific endpoint here (40:41).

topics.headline: scope over paired title endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the goal as the full paired title complex, not only the first title.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes al-ʿAzīz the governed complement and al-Ghaffār its apposition in the same endpoint phrase.

topics.headline: endpoint, not purpose-action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the structural contrast between recruitment into actions and orientation toward a named destination.
topics.reason: The earlier lām purpose frame and later ilā endpoint frame are both locally present and syntactically distinct.

topics.headline: 40:41 destination refined
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the ilā direction from 40:41 to 40:42, where the speaker now names the salvific endpoint (40:41).
topics.reason: The boundary rows give concrete continuity with 40:41 while the local phrase supplies the title endpoint.

words.gloss_range: first definite divine title in the ilā-governed paired endpoint
words.root_gloss_range: strength, honor, preciousness, resistance, and unassailable authority; locally the divine title answering rival association
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْعَزِيزِ}} ({{tr:al-ʿazīz}}) is the first named endpoint after ilā, not ornamental description. Its definite genitive form carries into the apposed al-ghaffār, building one destination phrase. Lexically, the title answers the proposed shirk relation by naming authority no rival can divide, and its position before forgiveness means the counter-call is neither weak pardon nor bare force. The paired title formula also recalls 39:5, where the same pair closes a creation context before being brought into contested persuasion here (39:5).

topics.headline: first governed endpoint title
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees al-ʿAzīz as the first part of the destination itself, not a decorative adjective.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence confirm genitive government by ilā and apposition with the following title.

topics.headline: unshared authority against shirk
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the title answers proposed association with enduring, unbreached authority.
topics.reason: The ʿ-z-z lexical field is locally narrowed by the preceding shirk issue and the definite divine title form.

topics.headline: recognizable title formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader connects the pair to 39:5, where the same title formula closes a creation context before 40:42 brings it into contested persuasion (39:5).
topics.reason: The concrete cross-reference and co-occurrence evidence support formulaic weight without overriding the local destination phrase.

topics.headline: power before forgiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the destination as power joined to forgiveness: authority is secured first, then repair opens.
topics.reason: The order, shared definiteness, genitive case, and apposition are all local and support the paired-endpoint payoff.

words.gloss_range: intensive forgiveness title completing the destination and reversing the kufr covering image
words.root_gloss_range: covering, shielding, forgiving, and repeated repair; locally abundant divine forgiveness after exposed kufr and shirk
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْغَفَّٰرِ}} ({{tr:al-ghaffār}}) stays inside the same ilā destination by genitive apposition, so forgiveness is part of the goal rather than a detached softening. Its gh-f-r covering field answers ʾakfura: human covering denies truth, while divine covering repairs fault. The faʿʿāl pattern makes that forgiveness abundant or repeated, and the doubled sound pressure reinforces that intensity. The closing title links repair to repentance and guidance in 20:82 and to the surah-local forgiveness thread at 40:3, 40:7, and 40:55 (20:82; 40:3; 40:7; 40:55). The ayah final word leaves the last pressure as return and repair, while the shared f-r sound frame lets culpable covering and forgiving covering answer each other audibly.

topics.headline: forgiveness inside the same destination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees forgiveness grammatically included in the call goal, not added as sentiment after the fact.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms apposition to al-ʿAzīz inside the same ilā-governed phrase.

topics.headline: protective covering reverses kufr
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees two coverings answer each other: demanded denial covers truth, while the final title covers fault protectively.
topics.reason: The gh-f-r lexical range is locally contrasted with earlier k-f-r and preserved as a semantic reversal, not a replacement of the local title sense.

topics.headline: intensive repeated forgiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the form itself presents forgiveness as abundant or repeated, even for those urging kufr and shirk.
topics.reason: The faʿʿāl pattern and doubled consonant support intensity while local grammar keeps the word as a divine title.

topics.headline: repair after wrong thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader links the closing forgiveness to repentance and guidance in 20:82 and to the surah-local forgiveness thread at 40:3, 40:7, and 40:55 (20:82; 40:3; 40:7; 40:55).
topics.reason: The rows supply concrete references, and the local closing title makes them relevant as repair after exposed error.

topics.headline: final word as repair closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah end not on the opponents error but on the offered possibility of repair.
topics.reason: The closure position is surface-local and converges with the semantic reversal and intensive form named by the CRITICAL synthesis.

topics.headline: audible covering contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the f-r sound frame link culpable covering and forgiving covering while the changed onset reverses the moral direction.
topics.reason: The sound contrast is retained as acoustic payoff, bounded by the locally established lexical contrast between k-f-r and gh-f-r.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated د ع و frames the contrast between تدعونني and أدعوكم, while the lam-clause and ila-phrase give the two calls opposed directions.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calling inclines an addressee by speech. Their call aims to produce concealment of God and allocation of a partner; the speaker's counter-call directs them instead toward invincible power joined to repeated forgiveness.

activation_trace.role: Calling and verbal inclination supply the directional force shared by both halves of the contrast.
Concealment or denial of truth supplies the first intended effect of their call.
Shared participation supplies the second intended effect: introducing another into what belongs to God.
Power and inviolability make the speaker's destination resistant to the rival call.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer makes forgiveness the restorative end of the counter-call.

changed_reading.before: The speaker contrasts two religious appeals.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages two directional speech systems: one tries to produce concealment and shared divinity, while the other redirects its hearers toward unassailable, restorative divine agency.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object of أشرك is qualified by ما ليس لي به علم.
baseline_models.mechanism: Partnership is treated as an allocation of participation that requires a knowable basis. The negated state of knowledge, reinforced by the branch image of a distinguishing mark, blocks assignment of any divine share to the proposed other.

activation_trace.role: Participation held between parties supplies the allocation that the speaker refuses to make.
Present-state negation removes any existing epistemic basis for the proposed partnership.
Recognition and disclosed knowledge supply the missing warrant.
A distinguishing mark that guides to its referent makes the absence of any identifying evidence concrete.
Worship and the worshipped establish the exclusive relation into which an unsupported participant would be inserted.

changed_reading.before: The speaker merely says that he does not know the alleged partner.
changed_reading.after: The speaker enacts epistemic non-participation: without disclosure or a distinguishing sign, he will not allocate a share in worship by assertion alone.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أكفر and الغفار place two cover-images on opposite sides of the verse.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same material operation is ethically reversed. Kufr covers or suppresses God, truth, or benefaction; the Ghaffar covers sin in order to preserve the sinner from its consequence. Aziz adds the power that makes the preserving cover effective.

activation_trace.role: Literal covering supplies the suppressive operation demanded by the hostile invitation.
A cover that guards what it encloses supplies the protective reversal.
Covering sin and shielding its bearer specifies the beneficial object and result of the second cover.
Invincible strength makes the protective covering more than concealment.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief and forgiveness are separate theological opposites.
changed_reading.after: The invitation is a contest between two coverings: a human act that obscures the divine and a divine act that covers culpability so the human can be preserved.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus ending recombines the surah's opening names. Aziz returns from the descent formula, focal no-knowledge stands against Alim, and Ghaffar intensifies the opening Ghafir. The speaker's counter-call therefore routes his audience back to the revealed source already characterized by knowledge, power, and pardon.

activation_trace.role: The speaker's negated recognition forms the epistemic gap answered by the opening divine name.
Invincible power is the repeated name that ties the focal destination to the source of the book.
Repeated forgiveness turns the destination into a return to the surah's initial offer of pardon.
Power and inviolability characterize the source from which the book descends.
Complete recognition at the surah's opening contrasts with the speaker's refusal to claim unsupported knowledge.
Forgiving sin supplies the opening offer that the focal title Ghaffar renews and intensifies.

structural_cues: 40:2 closes the descent formula with Al-Aziz Al-Alim, and 40:3 opens with Ghafir al-dhanb.
40:42 places negated ilm immediately before the destination Al-Aziz Al-Ghaffar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the recurring names and their positions; I infer that the focal counter-call deliberately returns hearers to the surah's opening source. A live alternative is ordinary thematic reuse of divine names rather than a designed return.

changed_reading.before: Al-Aziz Al-Ghaffar are fitting attributes appended to the speaker's appeal.
changed_reading.after: The names act as a retrieval address: the believer sends his audience back to the knowledgeable, powerful, forgiving source announced at the surah's opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier call-scenes expose a conditional switch: being called to faith produces disbelief, and invoking God alone produces disbelief, while introducing partnership produces assent. The focus does not merely list two errors; تدعونني لأكفر وأشرك names the output that this established call-program tries to reproduce in the speaker.

activation_trace.role: Verbal inclination anchors the present attempt to move the speaker into the earlier response pattern.
Denial of truth is the first programmed response.
Making a partner for God is the condition under which the earlier audience becomes receptive.
Repeated denial brackets the recalled moment when they were called to faith.
The earlier call toward faith supplies the rejected input to the behavioral switch.
Invocation makes the audience's opposed responses directly comparable.
Divine uniqueness without partner supplies the condition that they reject.
Denial is the response activated by exclusive invocation.
Adding a partner supplies the condition under which they instead assent.

structural_cues: 40:10 recalls that a call to faith was answered with disbelief.
40:12 pairs disbelief when God alone is invoked with belief when partnership is introduced.
40:42 repeats the same sequence as the intended effects of their call.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated conditional sequence; I infer that the current invitation attempts to install that response pattern in the believer. A live alternative is that 40:10-12 describes a broader class rather than the immediate addressees alone.

changed_reading.before: The addressees advocate disbelief and polytheism as two related propositions.
changed_reading.after: Their invitation operates like a loyalty switch: exclusive divine address is to trigger refusal, while shared divinity is to trigger acceptance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The believer first asks to be followed along a rightly directed path, then names the rival calls' terminal states as rescue and fire. The focus unfolds those destinations into their operating commitments: kufr and shirk are the road into fire, while orientation to Aziz and Ghaffar is the road of extraction and rescue.

activation_trace.role: The two calls provide the directional operator whose routes and endpoints the context reveals.
Following behind someone turns the believer's speech into offered leadership along a route.
Gentle indication toward road and truth supplies the manner of his counter-leadership.
An extended traversable road gives the invitation a spatial and processual form.
A straight route away from error specifies the quality of the believer's proposed path.
The immediately preceding mirrored calls explicitly connect the two speakers to opposite destinations.
Rescue by separation supplies the extraction achieved by the believer's route.
Kindled fire supplies the consuming terminal state of the rival route.

structural_cues: 40:38 offers followership, guidance, a path, and rectitude in one compact sequence.
40:39-40 insert the temporary world, settled abode, action, and recompense between route and destination.
40:41 contrasts rescue and fire; 40:42 immediately replaces those outcomes with the commitments and divine names that lead to them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies route vocabulary and explicit destinations; I infer that the focal grammatical complements are stages in those routes rather than detached doctrines. A live alternative is that 40:41 only summarizes the stakes while 40:42 independently specifies belief content.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts the doctrinal content of two invitations.
changed_reading.after: Each invitation is a traversable causal route: following one installs kufr and shirk and reaches fire, while following the other separates the hearer toward rescue under Aziz and Ghaffar.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later call-scenes test invitations by whether their endpoint can sustain a claim and answer. The proposed other has no call or claim in either world, all return to God, calls made in the fire go astray, and God alone explicitly pairs 'call Me' with 'I answer.' The focal contrast thus distinguishes a dead-end call from a reciprocal address.

activation_trace.role: The mirrored verbal calls anchor the question of which addressed destination can answer.
Calling is repeated while the invited object is denied any effective call in either world.
An asserted right or claim keeps open the alternative that the denied da'wah is standing rather than audible response.
Present-state negation removes effective call or valid claim from the proposed partner.
Return to the proper destination closes the failed rival circuit at God.
Calls from within the fire supply a failed communication circuit whose speech reaches no relief.
The divine imperative to call supplies the open side of a reciprocal address.
Answering speech completes the response circuit absent from the rival object.

structural_cues: 40:43 immediately denies da'wah to what they invite the believer toward and states the common return to God.
40:49-50 stage a request to call for relief whose ensuing calls are declared lost.
40:60 directly joins the imperative 'call Me' to the promise 'I answer you.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated da'wah, return, failed calls, and explicit answer; I infer that efficacy links these scenes and differentiates the focal destinations. A live alternative is that da'wah in 40:43 means a valid claim or intercession rather than response capacity.

changed_reading.before: Both sides possess formally comparable invitations.
changed_reading.after: The symmetry is only verbal: their invitation terminates at an object with no sustainable call or claim, while the believer's invitation enters a divine call-and-answer circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: After inviting them to Aziz and Ghaffar, the believer does not seize control; he transfers his affair to God, and protection from their plot follows. Divine power and protective covering become an enacted sequence of delegation and warding rather than titles used to overpower the audience.

activation_trace.role: Invincible strength supplies the agency to which the threatened speaker can entrust his affair.
A cover that guards what it encloses supplies the protective shape later made visible.
Returning one's affair to another in reliance transfers control from the speaker to the divine endpoint he names.
Warding off harm supplies the concrete protective result of that delegation.

structural_cues: 40:44 follows the invitation by entrusting the speaker's affair to God.
40:45 begins with the resulting divine protection from the evils of the plot.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate delegation followed by protection; I infer that this sequence operationalizes Aziz and the protective cover-image of Ghaffar. A live alternative is that the outcome vindicates trust narratively without unpacking the two names individually.

changed_reading.before: The believer invokes divine might and forgiveness as persuasive attributes.
changed_reading.after: He models their operation: relinquished control enters invincible agency, and that agency places a preserving barrier between him and the plot.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly describes disputation without a compelling warrant, delays forced knowledge until consequences arrive, and finally depicts people exulting in the knowledge locally possessed by them despite clear proofs. Against that pattern, the focal 'I have no knowledge of it' is disciplined restraint: the believer refuses to manufacture participation where no authority or sign has arrived.

activation_trace.role: Allocating shared participation is the act withheld pending warrant.
Negation marks a presently absent epistemic basis rather than an invented certainty.
A mark that reveals and guides to its referent supplies the evidence the alleged partner lacks.
Compelling proof supplies the authority explicitly absent from the disputants' case.
The repeated absence of compelling proof confirms a stable epistemic defect rather than a one-time omission.
Future recognition supplies knowledge imposed after rejection, too late to ground the earlier claim responsibly.
Exultant arrogance turns local knowledge into a closed affective possession.
Nearness and presence make their knowledge something merely 'with them,' set against what the messengers bring.
Their possessed recognition supplies the overconfident counterpart to the believer's candid epistemic limit.

structural_cues: 40:35 and 40:56 repeat the formula of arguing about God's signs without a sultan that came to the disputants.
40:70 postpones their knowing until after rejection of the book and messengers.
40:83 juxtaposes clear proofs with delight in the knowledge already 'with them.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies absent authority, delayed knowing, and self-satisfaction in possessed knowledge; I infer that the focal admission models responsible non-assignment. A live alternative is that it refers narrowly to not knowing any identity or reality for the proposed partners.

changed_reading.before: The believer answers a false claim by admitting personal ignorance.
changed_reading.after: His admission is an epistemic discipline opposed to arrogant pseudo-possession: absent authoritative disclosure, no participant may be inserted into divine worship.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the hunting-snare branch of ش ر ك rather than its ordinary theological branch. It remains anchored in the focal أشرك and gains visible support when later shirk is followed by collars, linked chains, dragging, and the disappearance of what had been called. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, not as the lexical definition of shirk in 40:42.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focal أشرك can retain the branch-distant image of entering a hunter's snare while still denoting the demanded partnership.

activation_trace.role: A hunter's snare supplies the exploratory image of participation as self-entanglement.
A collar binding a limb materializes the restraint latent in the snare image.
Connected links turn the claimed relation of partnership into a binding relation.
Dragging and extension supply the forced motion that follows capture.
The later interrogation about shirk reconnects the chain scene to the focal partnership root.
Their denial that they had called anything leaves the captives bound after the supposed partner vanishes.

changed_reading.before: Shirk is an abstract attribution of a divine share to another.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the invitation to shirk is an invitation into a relational snare: its claimed links disappear as partners but persist as the captive's bonds.

strongest_changes: The focal closing names return the believer's audience to the surah's opening source of knowledge, power, and forgiveness.
The earlier call-scenes reveal a conditional loyalty switch in which exclusive invocation triggers disbelief and partnership triggers assent.
The immediate route and destination sequence turns the two calls into causal paths toward rescue or fire.
The later negated, failed, and answered calls expose an asymmetry between a dead-end invitation and reciprocal divine address.
The speaker's lack of knowledge becomes disciplined refusal to assign divine participation without authoritative disclosure.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context made the focus operate simultaneously as a return to the opening names, the center of a repeated call-response pattern, a route choice in a threatened public argument, and an epistemic refusal that later self-satisfied knowledge throws into relief.
remaining_uncertainties: دعوة in 40:43 may foreground a valid claim or intercession more than response capacity.
The opposed-covering model is lexically anchored but its shared material image may be associative rather than an intended local contrast.
The snare-and-chain activation is deliberately exploratory and should not displace the ordinary partnership sense of ش ر ك.
The narrative sequence supports causal readings, but some links may be thematic juxtaposition rather than encoded causation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The opposed invitations differ by epistemic and protective destination.** `د ع و/B001` repeats; `ش ر ك/B001` adds an ungrounded partner, while `غ ف ر/B001` offers protective covering and `ع ز ز/B001` invulnerable might. I infer that a call inherits the properties of what it approaches. One recruits into unsupported distribution; the other into powerful protection.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The partners’ disappearance in 40:73–74 confirms the epistemic defect here: the ungrounded addressee cannot sustain reciprocal agency when tested.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The rival object lacks any distinguishing mark that can anchor allegiance.** Lexically, `ع ل م:B002` is "a distinguishing mark that points to something," `ش ر ك:B001` is partnership, and `غ ف ر:B001` protective covering. Structurally, the court has received manifest demonstrations, the two calls in 40:41 diverge, and 40:43 says the rival object has no effective call in either domain. The absent mark's role is evidentiary: nothing identifies the proposed partner as able to bear the relation demanded. The packet gives `ما لي به علم` beside named divine capacities; I infer that valid allegiance requires a traceable capacity. The lack of knowledge reads as absence of any pointing evidence, not merely the speaker's incomplete information.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later 40:63 supplies knowing denial and 40:83 supplies exultation in possessed knowledge; together they sharpen the missing mark into refusal of external correction, not innocent ignorance.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ses ve söz yoluyla bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmeyi temel anlam olarak verir; yemeğe çağırmayı ve bir yere yönelmeyi de bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlar olarak gösterir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel seslenme anlamı, yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen yemeğe çağırma ve bir yere yönelme kullanımlarından ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın seslenme çekirdeğini kapsar; yemeğe çağırma ile belirli bir yere yönelme anlamları yalnızca kendi yapıları içinde geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Ses ve söz kullanarak birini ya da bir şeyi konuşana doğru yöneltmektir. Yemeğe çağırma ve bir yeri amaçlayıp oraya gitme, bu çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Ses ve söz, yöneltilen kişiyi ya da şeyi konuşana doğru çekmenin aracıdır.
Yemeğe çağırma, yöneltme çekirdeğinin belirli bir etkinliğe bağlı özel kullanımıdır.
Belirli bir yeri amaçlayıp oraya gitme, yerin kişiyi çağırdığı varsayımıyla anlatılan mecazlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, ses ve sözle kendine yöneltme çekirdeğini; yemeğe çağırmayı ve bir yeri amaçlayarak oraya gitmeyi bu çekirdeğe bağlı kullanımlar halinde birlikte sunar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sesli ve sözlü bir çağrının hedefi konuşana ya da onun belirlediği yöne çektiği temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ses ve söz aracını, yöneltme hareketini ve konuşana doğru oluşan yönü birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye seslenip onu konuşana veya belirlenen yere yöneltme bağlamlarında doğal bir karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Seslenme ve hedefi bir yöne çekme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemeğe çağırma ile yerin çağırdığı varsayımına dayanan yönelme uzantılarını tek başına göstermez.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca birini yemek için çağıran özel yapı söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiyi ses ve sözle belirli bir etkinliğe yöneltme anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel çağırma çekirdeğini ve yer yönelimi uzantısını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca kişinin belirtilen yeri hedefleyerek oraya yöneldiğini anlatan özel yapı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli bir yere yönelme ve o yeri amaçlama sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Yerin kişiyi çağırdığı varsayımını ve genel seslenme çekirdeğini açıkça taşımaz.

error_profile.preserves: Birini belirli bir şeye yöneltme düşüncesini kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Ses ve sözle kendine yöneltme çekirdeğini ve yer yönelimi uzantısını kapsamaz.
error_profile.adds: Türkçede toplumsal veya resmî bir etkinliğe çağırma çağrışımını öne çıkarabilir.
error_profile.collision: Yalın seslenme ile yapıya bağlı yemeğe çağırma anlamlarının sınırını belirsizleştirir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hedefi ses ve sözle konuşana doğru yöneltme ilişkisini kurar; sesin yüksek olması zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Çağrının yönünden çok sesin yükseltilmesini ve güçlü biçimde duyurulmasını öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişiye sesle ulaşma ve onu çağırma alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda belirleyici unsur sözlü çağrıyla yöneltmedir; komşuda ise çağrının yüksek ve güçlü sesle yapılması başlı başına anlam çekirdeğidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birini ses ve söz yoluyla kendine doğru yöneltme eylemini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yaklaşmayı isteyen kalıplaşmış bir emir ve ünlem işlevi taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir muhatabı konuşana ya da belirtilen noktaya yaklaşmaya yöneltir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel çağırma eylemidir; komşu dal ise yaklaşma isteğini bildiren belirli bir emir ifadesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Seslenme aracılığıyla muhatabın yönelmesini sağlayan eylemi anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yakın veya uzak muhataba seslenmede kullanılan çağrı parçacıklarını adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir muhataba yöneltilen sözlü çağrı alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çağırma eyleminin kendisini tanımlar; komşu dal o eylemde kullanılan dil bilgisel seslenme araçlarını tanımlar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı. Yayınlanan üç komşu, çağırma eylemini yüksek ses, yaklaşma emri ve seslenme parçacığından ayırır; diğer adaylar ya daha uzak bir ortak sahne paylaşır ya da kardeş dallardaki ayrı anlamları yineler.
branches.what_is_ar: الدعاء والنداء والإمالة إلى الشيء بصوت وكلام والدعوة إلى الطعام وقصد المكان بدعائه مجازا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس ادعاء النسب ولا ادعاء الحق ولا تداعي السقوط ولا دواعي الدهر
branches.source_phrase_ar: أصل واحد وهو أن تميل الشيء إليك بصوت وكلام يكون منك؛ دعوت أدعو دعاء؛ الدعوة إلى الطعام بالفتح؛ دعا فلانا مكان كذا إذا قصد ذلك المكان كأن المكان دعاه

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ileri sürmesini temel alır; soy ve çocuk bağı iddiası ile savaşta soyunu bildirerek kendini tanıtmayı aynı iddia alanında özel biçimler olarak verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Hak ileri sürme, soy bağı kurma ve savaşta aidiyet bildirme ayrımları korunur; bunlar sıradan seslenme anlamına indirgenmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel hak ileri sürme biçimi ile soy ve savaş bağlamlarına bağlı yapılar ayrı tutulur; özel kullanımlar yalın biçimin tamamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ya da aidiyet bağı ileri sürmesidir. Soy veya çocuk bağı kurma ve savaşta soyunu söyleyerek kendini tanıtma, bu iddia eyleminin özel biçimleridir.

facets.statement: Bir hak, kişinin kendisi ya da başka biri lehine ileri sürülür.
Bir çocuk veya kişi için soy bağı ileri sürülerek onu belirli bir babaya ya da soya bağlama anlamı vardır.
Savaş bağlamında kişi soyunu söyleyerek kendini ve bağlı olduğu topluluğu bildirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu iddia, hak ileri sürme çekirdeği yanında soy veya çocuk bağı kurmayı ve savaşta soy bildirerek kendini tanıtmayı birbirinden ayrılan özel gerçekleşmeler olarak kapsar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem bir hak talebini hem de soy veya topluluk bağı iddiasını ortak çekirdekte anlatmak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: İleri sürme eylemini, hak konusunu ve aidiyet bağı kurulabilmesini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına bir hak ileri sürdüğü bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir hakka sahip olunduğunu ileri sürme eylemini korur.
error_profile.loses: Soy bağı ve savaşta aidiyet bildirme kullanımlarını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiyi belirli bir baba, soy veya toplulukla ilişkilendiren iddia için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Soy ilişkisini iddia yoluyla kurma anlamını korur.
error_profile.loses: Soy dışındaki hak iddialarını ve savaş bağlamındaki kendini tanıtma işlevini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin savaş sırasında hangi soydan geldiğini söyleyerek kendini tanıttığı özel kullanım içindir.

error_profile.preserves: Savaş bağlamını, soy bildirimini ve kendini tanıtma işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Genel hak iddiasını ve başkasına soy bağı yükleme kullanımını kapsamaz.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kendisi veya başkası adına hak iddia etme

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiye yönelen eylem düşüncesini çok genel biçimde korur.
error_profile.loses: Hak veya aidiyet ileri sürme işlemini bütünüyle kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Sesli bir çağrı yapıldığı anlamını gereksiz yere ekler.
error_profile.collision: Aynı kökün çağırma dalıyla karışır ve bu dalın iddia sınırını bozar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hak iddiasını, savaşta soy bildirimini ve kişinin kendisi veya başkası adına ileri sürülen bağı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin bir topluluğa veya öz babası dışındaki birine eklenmesi sonucuna odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin soy veya topluluk bağına iddia yoluyla yerleştirilmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal daha geniş bir iddia alanına sahiptir; komşu dal özellikle kişinin başka bir soya ya da babaya bağlanması işlemiyle sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir hak veya soy bağı ileri sürme niteliğini taşır ve ileri sürülen bağ doğru ya da yanlış olabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişiyi babasına ya da topluluğuna bağlama ve o aidiyeti bildirme eylemini iddia niteliği aramadan kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Soy veya topluluk aidiyetini dile getirme ve savaşta bu bağla tanınma alanları ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda bağ bir iddia olarak ortaya konur; komşuda ağırlık, var olan aidiyeti bir baba veya topluluğa bağlayarak bildirmededir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Soy bağını ileri sürülen bir hak veya iddia olarak ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Akrabalık bağlarını, soy bilgisini ve kişi, yer ya da mesleğe nispeti geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişilerin bir soya veya topluluğa bağlanması alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal iddia eylemini gerektirir; komşu dal ise iddia bulunmasa da soy ve nispet ilişkilerinin kendisini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi. Seçilen komşular, soy iddiasını başka bir soya bağlama, aidiyet bildirme ve genel soy ilişkisi alanlarından ayırır; kalanlar daha dar tarihsel kullanımlar, uzak çağrışımlar veya kardeş dallardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlamak amacıyla memede bilerek bırakılan süt miktarını açıkça tanımlar; hazırlanan dal çerçevesi bu amaç ve araç ilişkisini doğru korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnızca memede bırakılan sütün sonraki sütü çekmesi düşüncesine bağlıdır; genel süt kalıntısına yayılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca verilen sütçülük yapısına bağlıdır ve kökün yalın biçimine bağımsız bir anlam olarak aktarılamaz.

concept_map.definition: Sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlamak için sağım sırasında memede bilerek bırakılan süt payıdır.

facets.statement: Sağımda sütün bir bölümü memede bilerek bırakılır.
Bırakılan payın işlevi, ardından gelecek sütün akışını uyarmaktır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, memede süt bırakma işlemini ve bu işlemin sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlama amacını ayrılmaz biçimde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: sütün devamını çekmek için memede bırakılan pay
concept_gloss.applicability: Sağımda kalan sütün tesadüfi değil, sonraki sütün gelmesini uyarmak için bilerek bırakıldığı özel kavramı karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Süt payını, memede bırakılmasını ve sonraki sütü getirme amacını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sütçülük bağlamında, sonraki sütün akmasını sağlamak üzere memede bırakılan miktarı kısa biçimde anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Bırakılan payın sağımın devamını sağlama işlevini korur.
error_profile.loses: Payın özellikle memede bırakıldığını ve sonraki sütü çektiğini açıkça söylemez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: sonraki sütü çekmek için memede bırakılan süt payı

error_profile.preserves: Sağım sonrasında memede bir miktar süt bulunmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Sütün bilerek bırakılmasını ve sonraki sütün gelmesini sağlama amacını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Memede kalan sütün sonraki sütü getirmesi için bilerek bırakılmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memede kalan sütün az ve yudumluk miktarda oluşunu anlatır; özel bir işlev şart koşmaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sağım sonrasında memede bulunan küçük bir süt miktarını konu eder.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalanın amacıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise miktarın azlığıyla tanımlanır ve sonraki sütü çekme işlevini gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Süt akışını uyarmak için memede bırakılan sütün kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Memeyi sıvazlayarak sütü indirme eylemini ve bu yolla süt veren hayvanı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da memeden yeni süt akışını başlatma veya sürdürme amacı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda uyarıcı araç memede bırakılan süt payıdır; komşuda araç memenin sıvazlanmasıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir miktar sütü sonraki akışı sağlamak üzere memede bırakmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Parmak uçlarıyla az az sağmayı, yavaş akışı ve kalan sütü çekip almayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da memedeki az miktardaki süt ve sağımın sürdürülmesi alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sütü bırakır ve işlevini bekler; komşu dal az miktardaki sütü belirli bir sağım biçimiyle dışarı alır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tamamı incelendi. Seçilen komşular, amaçlı bırakılan süt payını az süt kalıntısından, memeyi sıvazlamaktan ve az az sağmaktan ayırır; öteki adaylar sağımın başka aşamalarına veya kardeş anlamlara aittir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: داعية اللبن ما يترك في الضرع ليدعو ما بعده

identity_judgment.rationale: Hazırlanan çerçeve bunu birine kötülük gelmesi için söz söyleme olarak sunarken kaynak ifadesi, Tanrı'nın kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı şeyi getirmesini ve olayın gerçekleşmesini anlatır. Dal korunabilir, ancak tanım sözlü dilekten gerçekleşen sıkıntıya kaydırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam, belirli yapıda Tanrı'nın istenmeyen bir şeyi kişinin başına getirmesidir; kötülük dileme eylemi değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Düzeltilen anlam yalnızca verilen Tanrı, kişi ve istenmeyen sonuç yapısında geçerlidir; yalın çağırma anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli yapıda, Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına onun hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesini anlatır. Odak, birinin kötülük dilemesi değil, istenmeyen olayın kişiye yönelip gerçekleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Tanrı, kişiye onun hoşlanmadığı bir şeyi yöneltir ve başına getirir.
Kaynak açıklaması sözlü bir kötülük isteğini değil, istenmeyen sonucun kişide gerçekleşmesini öne çıkarır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynak iddiası, Tanrı'nın bir kişiye hoşlanmadığı şeyi indirmesi veya başına getirmesi sonucunu bildirir; sözlü bir kötülük dileme işlemi belirtmez.

concept_gloss.text: Tanrı'nın birine istemediği bir sıkıntıyı vermesi
concept_gloss.applicability: Tanrı'nın bir kişinin başına o kişinin hoşlanmadığı bir olay veya sıkıntı getirdiğini bildiren özel yapı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Eyleyenin Tanrı olmasını, etkilenen kişiyi ve onun istemediği sonucun gerçekleşmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eyleyeni geri planda bırakıp kişi açısından gerçekleşen istenmeyen sonucu anlatmak gerektiğinde kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntının gelmesi sonucunu korur.
error_profile.loses: Sonucu Tanrı'nın meydana getirdiğini açıkça belirtmez.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı'nın birinin başına hoşlanmadığı bir sıkıntıyı getirmesi

error_profile.preserves: Bir kişiye yönelen istenmeyen sonuç düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Kaynakta bildirilen gerçekleşmiş ilahi yöneltme ve meydana gelme ilişkisini kaybeder.
error_profile.adds: Bir insanın sözlü istekte bulunduğu ayrı bir konuşma eylemi ekler.
error_profile.collision: Sonucun gerçekleşmesini, o sonucun gerçekleşmesini isteme eylemiyle karıştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı'nın istenmeyen şeyi kişinin başına getirmesi ve sonucun gerçekleşmesi anlatılır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir kişinin başkasına kötülük yönelten söz söylemesi öne çıkar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirli bir kişinin başına kötü bir şey gelmesi düşüncesini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gerçekleşen ilahi yöneltmeyi bildirir; komşu dal ise kötü sonucun gerçekleşmesi için söylenen sözü anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İstenmeyen sonucun Tanrı tarafından kişiye verilmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Lanetleme ve karşılıklı olarak yalancının cezalandırılmasını isteme törenlerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da Tanrı ile ilişkilendirilen kötü bir sonucun kişiye yönelmesi sahnesini paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal sonuç bildiren özel bir yapıdır; komşu dal sözlü lanetleme veya karşılıklı sınama eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sıkıntının belirli bir eyleyen tarafından kişiye getirilmesi ilişkisini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sıkıntı, zarar veya güçlüğün kendisini ve onun yoğunluğunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin yaşadığı hoş olmayan ve zarar verici durumu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal sıkıntının kişiye yöneltilmesini anlatır; komşu dal yönelten bir eyleyen gerektirmeden sıkıntı durumunu adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı. Seçilenler gerçekleşen sıkıntıyı kötülük dileme, lanetleme ve sıkıntının kendisinden ayırır; kalanlar uzak sonuç türleri veya bu kökün başka dallarıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki bağlı süreci açıkça verir: duvarların birbiri ardından çökmesi ve yapıların birbiri ardından yıkılması. Hazırlanan çerçeve, ardışıklığı ve çökme ile ettirgen yıkma ayrımını korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Birbiri ardından gerçekleşme her iki kullanımda da kurucudur; tek bir çökme veya tek seferde yıkma dalın tamamını karşılamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Kendiliğinden ardışık çöküş ile bir eyleyenin ardışık yıkması ayrı yapılara bağlı iki facet olarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yapının parçalarının birbiri ardından çökmesi veya bir eyleyenin onları birbiri ardından yıkmasıdır. Her iki durumda da tek olay değil, birbirini izleyen bir bozulma dizisi vardır.

facets.statement: Yapısal bozulma tek seferde değil, parçaların birbirini izlemesiyle gerçekleşir.
Duvarlar veya yapı parçaları kendiliğinden birbiri ardından çöker.
Bir eyleyen, yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine birbiri ardından yıkar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, ardışık çöküşü ve ardışık ettirgen yıkmayı aynı sıra ilişkisi altında birleştirir; eyleyenin bulunup bulunmaması iki kullanımı ayırır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem yapı parçalarının sırayla çökmesini hem de bir eyleyenin onları sırayla yıkmasını kapsayan üst karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Ardışıklığı, yapısal bozulmayı ve kendiliğinden çökme ile ettirgen yıkma seçeneklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Duvar veya yapı parçalarının kendiliğinden ve sırayla düştüğü kullanım için doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Yapı parçalarının ardışık biçimde çökmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir eyleyenin parçaları birbiri ardından yıkması kullanımını kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir eyleyenin yapı parçalarını hedefin üzerine sırayla yıktığı kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ettirgen yıkmayı ve parçaların sıra ile devrilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yapının kendiliğinden ardışık çökmesi kullanımını kapsamaz.

error_profile.preserves: Yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirerek düşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Parçaların birbiri ardından gelmesini ve ettirgen yıkma kullanımını kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çöküşün veya yıkmanın parçalar arasında sıra halinde ilerlemesini ve ettirgen seçeneği kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin genel olarak düşmesi veya yıkılmasını, ayrıca ağacın kökünden çıkmasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir yapının ayakta kalma durumunu yitirip çökmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal için ardışıklık kurucudur; komşu dal tek bir çöküşü de kapsar ve sıra ilişkisi gerektirmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birbiri ardından çökme veya yıkma düzenini vurgular.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yıkılmanın taşıyıcı düzeni, gücü veya itibarı ortadan kaldıran sonucunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yapıların yıkılması ve ayakta tutan düzenin bozulması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal olayların sırasıyla tanımlanır; komşu dal ise yıkımın dayanıklılığı ve düzeni yok eden sonucuyla tanımlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birden çok parçanın birbirini izleyerek çökmesini veya yıkılmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yapının ya da kenarın yüksekten aşağıya veya çukura doğru çöküş yönünü öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yapı parçalarının düşmesi ve bütünlüğün bozulması olayını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırıcı özelliği ardışık sıra, komşunun ayırıcı özelliği ise aşağıya veya derine doğru çöküş yönüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi. Yayınlanan komşular ardışıklık sınırını genel çökme, sonucu öne çıkan yıkım ve aşağı yönlü çöküşten ayırır; kalan adaylar kırma, zayıflama, düzleme veya kardeş anlam alanlarında daha uzaktır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dönemin değişimlerini ve olayların yönünü değiştirmelerini anlatır. Hazırlanan çerçevenin olaylar ve yön verme bölümü uygundur, ancak insanın bu olaylara eğilmesi kaynakta kurucu bir katılımcı olarak açıkça verilmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanım, insanın yönelmesini değil, dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimlerini merkeze alır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca dönemin yön verici değişimleri yapısına bağlıdır; yalın biçime genel bir olay veya çağırma anlamı yüklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Dönemin olayların akışını başka yöne çeviren değişimleri ve getirdiği gelişmelerdir. Yöneltme düşüncesi burada sesli bir çağrı değil, olayların seyrine etki eden mecazlı bir güçtür.

facets.statement: Dönem, değişen koşullar ve gelişmeler yoluyla olayların akışına yön verir.
Olayların başka yöne çevrilmesi, temel yöneltme ilişkisini zamansal değişimlere taşıyan mecazlı bir uzantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek iddia, dönemin değişimlerini olayların yönünü etkileyen güçler olarak sunar; insanın bu değişimlere çekilmesi kaynak ifadesinde zorunlu bir öğe değildir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dönemin getirdiği değişimlerin olayların seyrini etkilediğini anlatan özel kullanım için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dönemin değişimlerini, olayları ve bu değişimlerin yön verici etkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yön verme benzetisini açmadan, dönem içinde meydana gelen değişim ve gelişmeleri doğal Türkçeyle anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Dönemin değişkenliğini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan olayları korur.
error_profile.loses: Bu değişimlerin olayların yönünü çevirdiği mecazlı ilişkiyi açıkça göstermez.

error_profile.preserves: Olayların yön verici bir etkisi olduğu düşüncesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Dönemin değişimleri ile olayların seyrinin yön değiştirmesi arasındaki bağı zayıflatır.
error_profile.adds: Kaynakta kurucu olmayan insan katılımcısını ve onun edilgin biçimde sürüklenmesini ekler.
error_profile.collision: Olayların yönünün değişmesi ile insanın olaylara kapılması birbirine karışır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Dönemin değişimlerini olayların yönünü etkileyen bir güç olarak kavramlaştırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dönemin insanlar üzerinde gerçekleşen türlü olaylarını ve bazı kullanımlarda gece ile gündüzü de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dönem içinde ortaya çıkan değişimleri ve olayların değişken seyrini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yön verme benzetisiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal daha genel olayları ve daha geniş zamansal kullanımları kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Değişimleri, olumlu veya olumsuz değer yüklemeden olayların yönünü değiştirmeleri bakımından ele alır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Beklenen veya korkulan uğursuz gelişmeler ve belirsizlik duygusunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da dönemin getirdiği değişimleri ve beklenmedik gelişmeleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal genel yön değişimini anlatır; komşu dal değişimlerin kaygı, kuşku ve kötü beklenti doğuran yönüyle sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların tümü karşılaştırıldı. İki yakın komşu, yön verici dönem değişimini genel dönem olaylarından ve kaygı uyandıran gelişmelerden ayırır; diğer adaylar ölüm, insanın durumu, yaklaşan sonuç veya kardeş anlamlarla daha dolaylı ilişkilidir.
